# Cricket required run rate

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/cricket-run-rate/

Calculate current and required cricket scoring rates using legal balls. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Enter a 180-run target in a 20-over match and a current score of 100 after 12.3 overs.

## Limits and checks

Cricket notation 12.3 means 12 overs and 3 legal balls, not 12.3 decimal overs. Adjust balls per over for your format.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
